core_obligations: Describe the index category and the presheaf (proof lines 10690-10700): for U with p(U) = V, the category I_U has objects the pairs (U', phi) with phi : U -> u(U') a morphism of the fibre category C_V, and F'_U sends (U', phi) to F'(U'); the restriction maps are constructed below.

Ameliorate the morphism (proof lines 10702-10714): choose the factorisation C' -> C'' -> C of u given by the amelioration lemma, so that g_! = g''_! o g'_! and similarly for derived functors, with g'_! exact by the modules-on-sites exactness lemma.

Reduce to the fibred case (proof lines 10715-10726): since g'_! is exact one has Lg_!(F') = Lg''_!(F'') with F'' = g'_!F' = h^{-1}F' for the morphism of topoi h attached to w; the functor u'' makes C'' a fibred category over C, so the known computation lemma for the fibred case applies to L_n g''_!.

Conclude (proof lines 10727-10732): the construction of C'' in the amelioration lemma identifies the index category and the presheaf for u'' with those displayed for u, so the homology description of L_n g_!(F') follows from the fibred-case computation.
proof_roadmap: Write down the index category I_U and the presheaf F'_U whose homology is claimed to compute L_n g_!.
Ameliorate the morphism so that the first factor has exact lower shriek and the second is fibred.
Apply the known computation lemma to the fibred part and identify the resulting index category with the one of the statement.
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the higher derived lower shriek L_n g_!F' along a morphism of fibred categories as the sheaf associated to U |-> H_n(I_U, F'_U) (statement lines 10677-10687). The proof (proof lines 10689-10732) introduces the index category of pairs (U', phi) over the fibre category, ameliorates the morphism to split off an exact piece, and reduces to the known computation lemma for the fibred case, identifying the index categories at the end. H2: one reduction through an ameliorated morphism plus one identification, written out.
